title: void-server
blurb: The box behind gloat.ing: Void Linux on a 1-core VPS, OpenResty at the front, Cloudflare in front of that, media on R2, an IRC server and a bot keeping watch. Secrets are cut out and marked <redacted:…>.

groups.title: openresty
groups.blurb: The web server: TLS, rate limits, NAXSI, the bot filter, and the Lua gate that hands out the media cookie.

files.desc: the whole server: TLS 1.3, HTTP/3, rate limits, NAXSI, old /void/ paths redirected to R2
security headers and the CSP (no inline scripts anywhere, so no hashes)
real visitor IPs from Cloudflare's ranges (kept current by cf-ips)
/void/login: passphrase in, HttpOnly cookie out
/dashboard: a small Lua status page behind basic auth

groups.title: cloudflare worker
groups.blurb: media.gloat.ing: serves the R2 library to logged-in visitors, draws fancyindex-style listings, and takes operator uploads into a separate bucket.

files.desc: buckets, the Durable Object, upload limits
router: cookie check, ranges, 304/416, listings, ?download
directory pages in nginx fancyindex markup, so the old theme still fits
cookie helpers shared by media and /_op/
/_op/: channel keys, links, multipart uploads, the admin route
Durable Object (SQLite): rate limits, daily bytes, pause switch, storage hard stop, event queue
checks an upload's first 4 KB against its extension
operator tool: channel keys, review queue, pause/resume, purge

groups.title: voidbot
groups.blurb: A small Go bot on the IRC server: posts uploads and library changes, answers !status, and writes the numbers the site's terminal shows.

files.desc: IRC connection, SASL with back-off, poll loop, owner-only commands
events to grouped IRC lines; strips control codes from user text
talks to the Worker's admin route
load, memory, disk, services, IRC users: sysinfo.json every 30 s
config loading and defaults
tests: grouping and injection
config shape (install.sh fills in the secrets)
build, system user, config, runit service
runit service: drops to its own user
one dependency: ergochat/irc-go

groups.title: ops
groups.blurb: The chores that keep it running: certificates, Cloudflare's IP list, encrypted backups, log rotation, fail2ban banning at the edge.

files.desc: daily tar + xz + age; only the PC holds the key, so the box can't read its own backups
syncs Cloudflare's ranges into realip, ufw and fail2ban, with sanity checks and rollback
Let's Encrypt renewals over DNS-01 for the web and IRC certs
installs a renewed cert, tests the config, reloads
weekly web/fail2ban logs, monthly IRC log
jails; web bans go to Cloudflare's firewall, ssh stays on ufw
the probe filter: only failed requests count

groups.title: shell
groups.blurb: Where I actually live on the box: fish, micro, btop, fastfetch.

files.desc: eza, bat, fzf, ps helpers, a few cd shortcuts
fisher + tide (the prompt)
the editor: twilight, softwrap, gofmt on save
btop
fastfetch layout: tree keys and Nerd Font icons
the logo, in braille
